notes.title: New Version Update v2.5
notes.content:
New Features:
Achievements System:
Attain special achievements and get rewarded.

New:
- New cards.
- 5 new quests.
- New portraits.
- New shop item “Package Deal”.
- Players now can browse a list of guilds to join.

Major Improvements:
- Great improvements on Live Battles system.
- System will undertake the losing bet for players in Coins Bet matches.
- Reducing the cost for card level resetting significantly for all players.
- VIP players will enjoy discounts for card level resetting from VIP1.
- President and Vice-President can expel members that are inactive for 7 days.
- Members that are inactive for 14 days will be expelled from guild by system.
- Guild War rewards share is now determined by 80% of member’s current season contribution and 20% of overall guild contribution.
- Each guild member’s share is limited up to 30% of the total Guild War Rewards.
- Adjust the prices for purchasing specific cards for VIP players.
- The cards given by daily login rewards will now be random.
- The base play rewards limit is increased from 200 to 400.
- Cards are now displayed in order of highest rarity.
- System will remember the last quest player played. To solve the issue when player are replaying a previous quest and have to relocate it each time.
- Main screen now displays server name.
- Amount of unique cards will be shown beside amount of all cards.
- Shop will display the actual discount for purchasing diamonds.

(Refer to "Upgrades" section in Game Library for detailed Logs)

notes.title: 策略性玩法介绍(中文版)
notes.content:
我们将向新玩家们介绍《究极卡牌决斗》的策略性玩法。

1. 游戏中每一张卡牌都是独特的，并且在设计上有它的优势与弱点。越稀有的卡牌并不意味着他们更好，只是提供给玩家更多选择性。

2. 攻击目标：所有的卡牌在战场时都会明智地根据自己的目标属性选择攻击目标。或许是针对虚弱，威胁还有造成范围攻击。这需要召唤师（玩家）在卡组里有针对性选择卡牌。

3. 每一张英雄卡（或单位卡）有其攻击类型与防御类型。比如，魔法攻击对重甲可以造成150%伤害。穿刺对轻甲造成75%伤害。战斗中还将护甲等级加入计算。

4. 魔法和陷阱卡是你征服敌人的战术性选择。魔法没有生命值，但是有各种作用效果。陷阱卡很强大但是只有特定条件下才能发动。选择正确的陷阱对于战斗有至关重要的影响。

5. 虽然每一张卡都有很全面的属性，不过游戏中战斗是以团队策略的形式。（卡组）选择正确的卡牌放置在同一卡组，会使他们战斗时更有效率。

6. 每一张卡都有冷却时间。有些速度快，有些速度慢。这是一个需要考虑的重要因素，你想要使用快攻还是防御战术，由你自己选择。

7. 最重要的是，所有卡牌都有它唯一的技能。了解每张卡的技能，使得他们有效地被使用是资深玩家的必备能力。

8. 游戏里存在不同阵营。阵营属性和阵营加成与相克有重要关系。它也是很多卡牌技能的一个计算因素。

9. 除了初级玩家的快速模式以外。目前游戏还有专业模式和核心模式可以让玩家在实时对站中做出战术选择与行动。玩家可以知道对手选择了什么卡牌或卡组，并且在下一步行动选择正确卡牌去克制。

10. 游戏中没有最强或无敌的卡组。建立正确的卡组去克制对手卡组是游戏胜利的关键。

11. 当你和同样玩家匹配对战多次以后。你会熟悉他/她拥有的卡牌和战术风格，而这将会演变成心理战。

我们希望你对游戏的策略性层面有了更好地理解。这只是一个基本的概述，真正的策略性还需要等你自己去体验。

notes.title: Strategic Gameplay
notes.content:
We will introduce to new players about the strategic gameplay about Epic Cards Battle in this post.

1. Each card in game is unique and designed to have its strength and weakness. Rarer cards don't mean they are better but only gives player more options to choose.

2. Attack target: All cards select their attacking targets wisely on battleground. Either targeting Weak, Threaten units or deal area damage. It's the summoner's (player) job on how to arrange their cards in a deck.

3. Each Unit card has attack type and armor type. e.g. For example, Magic against Heavy armor deals 150% damage. Pierce against Light armor deals 75%. There is also armor level factor taking into consideration.

4. Spell and Trap cards that are strategic options to help you conquer enemies. Spell has no hit points but with different effects. Trap cards are powerful but only activates if certain condition is met. Selecting correct trap(s) will make a huge difference in battle.

5. Though each card has its comprehensive properties, the battle is played in team strategy. (deck) Choosing the right cards into a deck, they will be much more efficient fighting.

6. Each card has its cooldown time. Some are quick, some are slow. It’s an important factor to take consideration, you want go for a rush or defense play, it’s up to you.

7. Most importantly, every card has its unique ability. Understanding each card's ability, place them in efficient use is what pro players do all the time.

8. There are different factions in game. Faction property will play a part in faction bonus and resections. It is also a factor in many cards’ abilities.

9. Except for Quick Mode for beginners. There are also Pro Mode and Hardcore modes in game that allow players to take action in real time against opponents. Player will know what cards or decks opponent choose and make their move based on it.

10. There is no single powerful card and unbeatable deck in game. Build the correct deck to win another is the key in this game.

11. When you matched players you played several times before. You know his cards and way of playing, it will become psychological warfare.

We hope you get a better idea about strategic gameplay of this game. This post is just a basic overview, there is much more waiting for you to find out yourself.
